newsitem.title: SPAIN: Argentaria to pay final 96 div of 77/ptas a share.
newsitem.headline: Argentaria to pay final 96 div of 77/ptas a share.

text.p: Spanish bank Argentaria said on Thursday it would pay a final 1996 dividend of 77 pesetas a share on July 7 and would begin quarterly payouts in September.

"Argentaria is beginning the payment of dividends to shareholders ever quarter. These payouts will take place in the first 15 days of September, December, March and June, preferably on the second Monday of each month," Argentaria said in a statement.
Up until now, the payout was made every four months.
"The final 1996 dividend of 77 pesetas a share will be paid on July 7," Argentaria said.
